item.title: PostgreSQL Operators for Kubernetes: CloudNativePG vs Zalando vs CrunchyData
item.description: Running PostgreSQL in Kubernetes has evolved from manual StatefulSet management to sophisticated operator-based automation. PostgreSQL operators handle cluster lifecycle, automated failover, backups, replication, and scaling through custom Kubernetes resources. In this comprehensive comparison, we examine the three leading PostgreSQL operators: CloudNativePG, Zalando Postgres Operator, and CrunchyData Postgres Operator (PGO).
